## Description

Constructs a four-leg vertical-spread box that approximates a fixed terminal cashflow and compares its implied financing rate to alternatives.

## Where it may fit

When option-implied financing differs from secured funding after fees and margin constraints.

## Vehicles

Options market makers, derivatives relative-value and specialist financing desks.

## Required data

Four option legs with common expiry/strikes, bid/ask, exercise/settlement details, rates, margin and transaction costs.

## Caveats

Margin treatment, early exercise, assignment, capital usage and settlement risk can erase apparent arbitrage.
